name: Konno Shuji
source: A self-proclaimed “spy hunter” who participates in the Forum on the Case Against Uniform Abolition. Pretends to be a nihilist who is against uniform optionalization. Acts like he’s smart, but he’s not that smart. Fast to agree with what others say.
